Multiple triplet-candidate unconventional superconducting phases have been reported in the heavy-fermion compound UTe2. Here, the authors find an enhancement of the electrical resistivity Fermi liquid coefficient A at a metamagnetic transition preceding the onset of superconductivity in magnetic fields higher than 40 T. The enhancement of A is attributed to a magnetic fluctuation mode probably in play for the mechanism of this superconducting phase.
